_about: FAMILY CARRIERS (re-audit decisions, operator, 15 Sep 2026): a row that carries its family's facts or document — a bare model row (Q-23) or a regional placeholder (Q-10 vs Q-23: Q-23 governs) — is the family's model row, not an orderable. It keeps its row and its device kind; the layers pages flag it `family_carrier`, and the `parts.family_carrier` column (migration 0022, set by scripts/family-carrier.mts in a recorded run) keeps any shop feed from listing it as orderable. Phase 2 inherits its facts to the orderable variants. facts / docs as measured on 15 Sep 2026.
